parties.note: Peronist party. Wikipedia lists Peronism, Kirchnerism and left-wing populism today; in 2000 it was led by Carlos Menem, whose governments (1989-1999) pursued market reforms, so big_tent is used. It ran as the core of electoral fronts that are recorded under this id in elections.json: Front for Victory (2003-2015), Citizen's Unity (2017), Frente de Todos (2019-2021), Union for the Homeland (2023) and Homeland Force (2025). In 2003 three Peronists ran for president on separate fronts. Leader gaps: Rubén Marín (interim, 2001), Ramón Ruiz (2005-2008), Scioli's 2009 interim, no leader 2004-2005 and 2014-2016 per Wikipedia; Luis Barrionuevo was court-appointed controller in 2018. Wikipedia's 'Beginning' section dates its creation to November 1946.

parties.note: Presidents of the National Committee not modelled: Roberto Iglesias (2005-2006), Ángel Rozas and Ernesto Sanz again briefly in 2011, Mario Barletta (2011-2013), José Manuel Corral (2015-2017), Alfredo Cornejo (2017-2021) and Leonel Chiarella (since 2025). Member of the Alianza (1997-2001) and of Cambiemos/Juntos por el Cambio (2015-2023), whose results are recorded under arg.alianza and arg.pro respectively. Led the Social and Civic Agreement (2009), the Union for Social Development (2011) and the Progressive, Civic and Social Front (2013), recorded under this id.

parties.note: Founded in March 2002 and headed by Ricardo López Murphy, who stood down after the 2003 election; absorbed by Republican Proposal in August 2009. López Murphy refounded a party of the same name in August 2020.

Formed as an alliance on 23 October 2005 and as a national party on 3 June 2010. Led the Cambiemos coalition (founded 15 June 2015, renamed Juntos por el Cambio 12 June 2019, dissolved 27 December 2023, with the UCR and the Civic Coalition), whose results are recorded under this id in elections.json. Mauricio Macri has been party president since May 2024 per the article's lead; Patricia Bullrich led the party before the 2023 election, but no dates are given, so earlier leaders are not modelled.

Coalition founded by Javier Milei and Victoria Villarruel (8 July 2021 in the infobox; formalised 14 July 2021 per the text); a party since 2024 (28 September 2024 in the infobox). Karina Milei is its party president (no dates). In 2021 its lists ran as 'Libertarians'.

parties.note: Trotskyist front of the Workers' Party (PO), Socialist Workers' Party (PTS), Socialist Left (IS) and Workers' Socialist Movement (MST); marxist_leninist is the nearest available sub-ideology. Leaders Nicolás del Caño and Myriam Bregman are named without dates.

Refounded on 28 June 2002 when the Popular Socialist Party and the Democratic Socialist Party reunited (the original party dates from 1896). Led the Broad Progressive Front (FAP) in 2011 and Progresistas in 2015, recorded under this id. Later presidents Antonio Bonfatti (from April 2016) and Mónica Fein (from 2021) are not modelled.
